test_explode_basic_scalar: test the DataFrame.explode method with a scalar column name to expand list elements into separate rows
test_explode_multi_columns: test the DataFrame.explode method with a list of column names to expand multiple list columns simultaneously
test_explode_multi_index: test the DataFrame.explode method preserves MultiIndex row indices when expanding list elements
test_explode_ignore_index: test the DataFrame.explode method with ignore_index=True to reset the index after expanding list elements
test_explode_error_handling: test the DataFrame.explode method raises ValueError for duplicate columns, nonempty column lists, and mismatched element counts
